description: SEC enforcement actions — Latest SEC enforcement actions: litigation releases, administrative proceedings and trading suspensions, newest first. Optional q= screens a company or person name (all words must appear; verdict MENTIONED or NOT_FOUND_IN_RECENT), type=all|litigation|administrative|suspensions, days= (only items newer than N days), limit=1-75 (default 25). Each item has kind, title (respondents), date, release number and the sec.gov link. Covers only the latest 25 items per SEC feed - not a full clean-record check. Source: SEC RSS feeds (US government, public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_enforcement
